name: n8n-outbound-sequencer-crm-suppression-sync
description: Bi-directional suppression firewall between HubSpot and Smartlead / Instantly: pushes closed-won customers, open-deal domains, competitor domains and do-not-contact opt-outs into global sequencer blocklists within seconds of CRM changes, and syncs sequencer opt-outs back to HubSpot. DRY_RUN and SANDBOX_MODE by default.
